components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--tajy-red, #d8132e); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--tajy-radius-md, 9px); padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--tajy-red-hover, #b8102a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--tajy-red-active, #a20e25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(216,19,46,0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with red focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--tajy-input-bg, #fff); color: var(--tajy-ink, #1a1a1a); border: 1px solid var(--tajy-border, #ddd); border-radius: var(--tajy-radius-md, 9px); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--tajy-red, #d8132e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(216,19,46,0.12); }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--tajy-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--tajy-border-light, #eee); border-radius: var(--tajy-radius-xl, 14px); box-shadow: var(--tajy-shadow-card, 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); padding: 20px; color: var(--tajy-ink, #1a1a1a); }

narrative.overview: A working counter, not a showroom. Numbers are the content; everything else steps back. Warm paper and white surfaces, near-black ink, and Tajy red reserved for action, selection, and brand.
keyCharacteristics: Red is scarce and meaningful (action, selection, brand).
Tonal, flat surfaces; shadow appears as a response to state.
Accessible contrast is a hard rule, with dedicated a11y token variants.
Same semantic tokens in light and dark; dark only redefines values.

rules.name: The Scarce Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks action or state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text colors must reach WCAG AA (4.5:1) on their actual background; use the -a11y / -fg variants.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Money and quote figures must align; use mono or tabular figures where amounts stack.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-State Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat; shadow and glow appear on hover, focus, or selection.

dos: Do use --tajy-* tokens for every color; add dark overrides in shared/theme-dark.css.
Do keep red for actions, selection, and brand.
Do verify 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.
donts: Don't hardcode hex colors in component CSS.
Don't use blue-tinted grays in the dark content area.
Don't add decorative shadows or gradients at rest in the light theme.
Don't put custom properties inside @media queries.
